diagnosis: The content checks do not require the settlement to be grounded in the hidden facts, so the registrar can assert the required correction and documentation commitments using generic administrative reasoning. The exact decision values can likewise be supplied without any credited or revealed support, leaving most hidden facts unenforced.
evidence: C1-C6 inspect only decisions and commitment types; unlike P1, they never require PF1, PF3, or PF4 in justification_fact_ids or revealed, and C5/C6 can be satisfied by generic commitments.
